rules.name: Expansion is a one-sided move with shallow pullbacks
rules.setupAnchor: Breakout or resumption from a smaller-range condition
rules.confirmationTrigger: Directional candle expansion plus shallow countertrend pullback behavior
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: Continuation structure should print protected swings that remain intact while the move persists
rules.invalidationCondition: Countertrend closure becomes deep enough to violate protected swing structure or higher-timeframe alignment fails
rules.targetLogic: Seek external liquidity in the direction of the move
exceptions: After multiple same-direction expansion days expect a possible phase change
Large opposing wick reduces clean expansion potential
machineChecks: Measure directional body percentile versus recent bars
Measure opposing wick ratio relative to total range
Track retracement depth versus anchor leg
ambiguityNotes: Shallow pullback threshold is not yet numeric
Large-range classification threshold is not yet numeric

rules.name: A candle supports expansion when body is large and opposing wick is small
rules.confirmationTrigger: Bullish candle forms a small lower wick early and pushes away from the open, or bearish candle forms a small upper wick early and pushes lower
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: Protected swing logic is stronger when the supporting candle also preserves directional intent
rules.invalidationCondition: A large opposing wick or strong opposing move reduces the candle's ability to support efficient trend continuation
rules.targetLogic: Use strong expansion-supporting candles to justify continuation expectations and weaker candles to reduce expectations
exceptions: Large higher timeframe opposing wick can still allow lower timeframe expansion, but targets should be more conservative
machineChecks: Compute body size as abs(close - open)
Compute opposing wick size as bullish lower wick or bearish upper wick
Compare opposing wick ratio to total range and body size
ambiguityNotes: Small-wick threshold is not yet numeric

rules.name: Expansion trades are strongest when higher and lower timeframes align
rules.setupAnchor: Higher timeframe establishes expected directional expansion
rules.confirmationTrigger: Intermediate timeframe confirms structure and lower timeframe confirms execution direction
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: Execution timeframe protected swing should agree with higher timeframe directional intent
rules.invalidationCondition: Lower timeframe setup points against higher timeframe expansion context
rules.targetLogic: Use higher timeframe objective with lower timeframe precision entry
exceptions: Two aligned timeframes may be enough, but three aligned timeframes are ideal
Below the four-hour chart, noise increases and reversal framing becomes less reliable
pineInputsNeeded: protected swing state on execution timeframe
ambiguityNotes: Timeframe combinations need narrowing to avoid excessive request complexity

rules.name: Expansion entries come after POI reaction and confirmation
rules.setupAnchor: Price taps a point of interest in the direction of the higher timeframe thesis
rules.confirmationTrigger: Bullish closure over opposing candle series or bearish closure under opposing candle series
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: Entry should use the new or most recent protected swing as the structural invalidation
rules.invalidationCondition: Protected swing is broken before the objective is reached
rules.targetLogic: Target prior external highs or lows and other liquidity objectives
exceptions: Do not force continuation if post-expansion consolidation has not taken external highs or lows
If risk/reward is weak, wait for a newer protected swing
If the higher timeframe candle has a large opposing wick, lower timeframe continuation targets should be more conservative
pineInputsNeeded: candle close relative to reference candle series
machineChecks: Require POI touch event before confirmation
Require bar-close confirmation beyond reference candle open or close
ambiguityNotes: Point of interest selection still contains discretion
Reference candle series needs a stricter algorithm

rules.name: Do not assume infinite continuation after repeated expansion
rules.setupAnchor: Sustained same-direction expansion across multiple higher-timeframe bars
rules.confirmationTrigger: Third same-direction expansion bar or visible post-expansion consolidation
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: Later protected swings still matter, but expectation should shift toward phase change risk
rules.invalidationCondition: New phase begins: consolidation, retracement, or reversal
rules.targetLogic: Reduce expectations and prefer phase transition handling over blind continuation
exceptions: This is a practical rule and may not hold in every strong trend
pineInputsNeeded: count of recent higher timeframe directional bars
machineChecks: Count consecutive higher timeframe expansion bars
Flag exhaustion risk when threshold is exceeded
ambiguityNotes: Three-day rule may be heuristic rather than universal
